v1.3.50v1.3.50当前版本 · 修复音效力度标定（碰撞/击球/进球/碰库随力度变化）Current · fix sound intensity calibration (collision/cue/pot/cushion vary with force)
v1.3.50 · 修复音效力度标定错误（球碰撞/击球/进球/碰库四类声音随力度变化）
· 根因：引擎球速量级为 maxPower = 160·R ≈ 5.24，实际碰撞/击球速度约 0.3 ~ 5.4；但 sound.ts 把力度参考速度设成碰撞 60 / 击球 70 / 进球 55，speed/refSpeed 恒 < 0.1，合成档位永远落在第 0~1 档（最软），力度差异完全听不出且整体偏软——即「球碰撞声音不对 / 进球的撞库声音不对」。
· 碰库声音不随力度变化：Cushion 原本用构建时固定的单一缓冲，音色一成不变、音量也被早早饱和，即「碰库的声音没按碰撞力度调整」。
· 修复：重新标定参考速度（碰撞 60→5、击球 70→5.2、进球 55→2.6、碰库按力度合成 refSpeed=6）；碰库 genCushion 改为带力度系数——轻碰 280Hz 长衰减柔软「噗」、重撞 640Hz 短衰减明亮「嗒」，音量 0.35→1.0 约 3 倍差。
· 自测：逐字复刻 DSP 渲染 WAV 量化——碰库频谱质心随力度 2463→3317Hz、碰撞 4242→5714Hz、进球 3048→3916Hz；映射对照表证实旧 refSpeed 把 0.3~6.0 全压在 0~1 档、新标定铺满 1~13 档。
约束：仅改音效合成与力度映射，不改动任何物理逻辑、挥杆动画、碰撞参数。 v1.3.50 · Fix sound intensity calibration (collision / cue / pot / cushion now vary with force)
· Root cause: the engine's ball-speed scale is maxPower = 160·R ≈ 5.24, with real collision/shot speeds around 0.3 ~ 5.4; but sound.ts used reference speeds of 60 / 70 / 55 for collision / cue / pot, so speed/refSpeed was always < 0.1 and the synthesis step was pinned to 0~1 (softest) — force differences were inaudible and everything sounded weak. That is the "ball-collision sound is wrong / pot cushion sound is wrong" report.
· Cushion sound didn't follow force: the Cushion branch used a single fixed buffer built at startup — constant timbre, and volume saturated early — i.e. "cushion sound isn't adjusted by impact force".
· Fix: recalibrate reference speeds (collision 60→5, cue 70→5.2, pot 55→2.6, cushion force-synthesized at refSpeed=6); genCushion now takes a force coefficient — light taps are a soft 280Hz long-decay "puff", hard hits a bright 640Hz short-decay "tok", with volume spanning 0.35→1.0 (~3×).
· Self-test: verbatim DSP re-implementation rendered WAVs show cushion spectral centroid 2463→3317Hz, collision 4242→5714Hz, pot 3048→3916Hz with force; the mapping table proves old refSpeeds collapsed 0.3~6.0 into steps 0~1 while new calibration spans 1~13.
Constraint: sound synthesis and force mapping only — no physics, swing animation, or collision params changed.
